checks: Connect source identity uses normalized origin, exact /pie path and one positive pieid without JS number rounding.
Dedicated browser launch claims one new bound page; cancellation reclaims only an owned lease, keeps committed sessions and does not terminate Connect or unrelated browsers.
HTTP probe is bounded by timeout, retries and body size; HTTP availability and rendered-player readiness never assert message connectivity.
Connect readiness requires a bound page, nonempty visible engine descendants and loaded image/video/canvas sizes; full-screen preparation also validates Stage ancestry and native D3 transform.
Connect layout leaves native transform/cursor untouched, fails closed for unknown Stage structures and explicitly rejects width-fill.
Input bind validates the captured dedicated browser PID/target/window/fullscreen viewport; subsequent checks retain source origin/path/pieid and timeOrigin binding.
HTTP cursor resources are accepted only for a bound Connect page on the same origin; Cloud source restrictions remain effective.
Playlist Connect native fit does not overwrite retained Cloud framing; Cloud-only controls remain source-specific.
